props.name: hint
props.description: Guidance shown under the control while it is valid.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Replaces the hint and marks the control invalid.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the label and forwards the requirement to the control.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the control.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Hide the label visually, keeping it for assistive tech.
